name: secure-ai-workshop
description: Workshop: Secure AI Features in Modern Apps

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --names contracts,api,web --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @workshop/contracts" "npm run dev -w @workshop/api" "npm run dev -w @workshop/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @workshop/api && npm run build -w @workshop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check:bundle: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @workshop/web && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
